summary: Iteration 2 focused on the 4 new enhancements (Code Pickers, Print Center, Structured Assessment CW09, Signature Sign-off). Added /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py with 8 pytest cases covering choices content, process-note code persistence, batch print (?household_ids=), assessment CRUD + print pre-fill, and sign-off RBAC + stamp visibility. All 8 backend tests passed. Frontend flows verified via Playwright end-to-end for admin/supervisor/caseworker: Print Center nav+page+conditional selects, code picker dropdowns (96 problem_codes options rendered in Select), Assessment page fields + save (no error toast), Supervisor sign-off dialog submits successfully, Caseworker correctly cannot see sign-off button and gets forbidden on /print-center.
critical_code_review_comments: Print endpoint continues to accept ?token= in URL. Print Center batch flow inherits this; consider signed short-lived tokens or POST-based signed URLs to avoid token leakage in referrer/server logs.

sign_checklist stamps the household record but there is no visible audit-log entry surfaced in the UI timeline for this action — consider emitting an AuditLog row so supervisors can see who signed and when.

core/views.py continues to grow (ViewSets + APIViews + custom actions + new AssessmentViewSet + sign_checklist). Recommend splitting into households.py / notes.py / assessments.py / print.py before it crosses 700 lines.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested testids present and interactive

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted TEST_ process notes and TEST_ assessments via API during tests; a supervisor sign-off with SACSSP-UI-7777 was applied to one seeded household (TEST-0060 checklist_signed_* fields).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Two backend test suites: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (regression: auth, dashboard, 16 print forms, timeline, verification_count, bulk_reassign, process_notes) and /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (iteration_2 additions). Run both with `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v`. Frontend flows use data-testids as documented in the review request; households list uses [data-testid^='household-row-'] rather than <a href>. Login redirects to '/' (dashboard content), not '/dashboard' — use `text=Recent households` or wait for sidebar as ready indicator.
rca of the issue: No new bugs uncovered this iteration.
